ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels localized at distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast mottling and white pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes; remainder of the ventral surface is a contiguous low-intensity dark region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serrations along the entire trailing edge; larger amplitude peaks located at the mid-section of both lobes; finer serrations toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curvature transitioning to a sharp distal taper; symmetrical sweep profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct bilateral white tip pigmentation contrasting against a solid dark fluke body.
